title: The Receipt
subtitle: Two conditions on one reward, and both must hold
description: The task is an ordinary checkmark, so the quest completes on any press.
The reward is where the gate is: its claims are checked against two
conditions, and a list of conditions is an AND -- the advancement alone
does not open it, and neither do the logs alone.
The first condition asks for an advancement, which is the one gate that
the world itself records: `/advancement grant @s only minecraft:story/root`
is the same fact the condition reads. The second asks for eight items
of the `minecraft:logs` tag -- any log counts, because a tag condition
is about the tag rather than the item.
Read this file next to the_standing: there the reward's condition is a
score, here it is two other types, and the claim is refused the same
way in both -- with a message, and with the reward still waiting.
